data.body:
Draft candidate register before the challenge pass.

- D01. Add one canonical repository writing policy that defines ticket, ADR, internal documentation, external documentation, shipped help, comment, generated artifact, and evidence-corpus ownership.
- D02. Replace the Python-only comment guard with format-aware prose and paragraph checks across maintained textual surfaces. Preserve explicit exclusions for syntax, technical identifiers, generated outputs, third-party texts, and frozen evidence.
- D03. Perform a source-aware cleanup of maintained prose after the policy gate exists. Rewrite prohibited connectors, filler, authenticity padding, contractions, casual diction, and hard-wrapped Markdown through each canonical source.
- D04. Reduce README.md to installation, first use, product concepts, supported interfaces, and links. Move contributor process, implementation detail, gate internals, and architecture to their internal homes.
- D05. Separate client guidance from implementation and incident history in docs/user-guide.md, docs/config.md, docs/jira-sync-setup.md, docs/exit-codes.md, authentication guides, S3 guidance, and integration guides.
- D06. Correct the operation-certificate documentation set from current HMAC claims to the DSSE envelope and sshsig implementation. Preserve legacy HMAC text only where compatibility code still accepts it.
- D07. Correct ticket-model guidance across README.md, templates, demos, help, and examples. Document seven relations, optional relation selection for unlink, configured claim defaults, Jira-resolvable explicit assignees, and supported ticket identifier forms.
- D08. Correct import help and generated reference text to describe source_id idempotency, crash resumption, deferred push, and chunk-level commit behavior from src/rebar/_io/import_ndjson.py.
- D09. Correct missing or incomplete CLI option and close guidance through canonical help sources. Coordinate generated reference and top-level discovery work with RP-05 tickets loony-fabric-bunny and pettish-snippy-rasbora.
- D10. Expand truncated MCP tool descriptions and regenerate the MCP reference from registrar docstrings. Keep each description client-facing and preserve schemas and contracts.
- D11. Repair templates/rebar-usage.md, its synchronized templates/AGENTS.md region, docs/assets/rebar-demo.svg, packaged guides, and example skills. Remove rebar-repository assumptions from portable examples or label those examples as rebar development workflows.
- D12. Rewrite Jira onboarding and validation documentation around implemented bridge setup, required project configuration, maintained executable paths, harness safety, current limitations, and reproduction commands.
- D13. Resolve governance authority and reporting-channel gaps. Add an escalation contact that is distinct from the lead maintainer route, then align SUPPORT.md, GOVERNANCE.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, SECURITY.md, and mirror operations.
- D14. Reduce AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and related root policies to current contributor and agent process. Replace repeated explanations with pointers to the authoritative internal document.
- D15. Restrict docs/architecture.md, docs/event-schema.md, docs/concurrency.md, and docs/maintenance-audit-runbook.md to implemented architecture and current development process.
- D16. Remove obsolete remediation plans and completed execution records from living guidance after preserving unique history on their tickets. Correct deleted shell writer references and absent-feature claims.
- D17. Define required ADR lifecycle metadata and validate status, date, owner, ticket, decision relationships, implementation state, and applicability in addition to numbering and links.
- D18. Normalize the ADR set. Mark ADR 0042 and ADR 0090 as superseded, reduce execution transcripts and incident logs, and preserve decision, rationale, alternatives, invariants, consequences, and relationship links.
- D19. Promote the durable batch-runner seam from docs/design/batch-runner-seam.md into ADR 0003 or a new ADR. Move its implementation chronology to tickets.
- D20. Rewrite operational runbooks against effective configuration and maintained paths. Correct two-vote gate state, GitHub mirror capabilities, SSO links, and review-bot operations. Move rollout transcripts and incidents to tickets.
- D21. Define lifecycle and provenance metadata for research, calibration, experiments, archives, and frozen corpora. Keep procedures and reproducibility inputs separate from outcomes and production applicability.
- D22. Rewrite production comments and docstrings around nonobvious behavior, safety, ordering, ownership, failure semantics, concurrency, and external constraints. Move chronology to tickets or ADRs.
- D23. Add public API docstrings for unlink, tag, untag, archive, and compact in src/rebar/_lib_mutations.py.
- D24. Normalize reviewer prompts, criteria routing data, evaluation specifications, and schema descriptions without changing criteria meaning, labels, scoring intent, or machine contracts.
- D25. Rewrite diagnostics, logs, workflow annotations, shell output, and presentation strings while preserving error codes, field names, structured markers, compatibility tokens, and tested wording.
- D26. Rewrite test comments around protected invariants and failure oracles. Reduce workflow, infrastructure, configuration, and experiment comments to current operational rationale.
- D27. Complete third-party provenance and distribution notices. Cover the alias wordlist license, package license-files, NOTICE, the legacy wordlist header, and the vendored Jira Data Center Dockerfile revision and license.
- D28. Extend internal-link validation from docs to every maintained root, infra, example, template, package, and help document. Define source-aware exclusions for generated and frozen material.
- D29. Record canonical source ownership for every generated or synchronized artifact. Change generated output only through its source and verify regeneration in portable checks.
- D30. After the RP-05 registry cutover, verify that top-level help discovers explain, review-plan, review-code, verify-completion, scan-spec, and workflow without adding a competing implementation ticket.

This register is provisional. Every item still requires the two remaining shard reports and three independent filters. No project files changed.
